title: ASUS Vivobook S14 (S3407Q)
shortDescription: Snapdragon X powered 14-inch Copilot+ PC with OLED display options and long battery life.
description:
This Vivobook S14 runs the Snapdragon X processor with a 45 TOPS Hexagon NPU, making it a Copilot+ PC.

It offers FHD+ OLED or 2.5K display options, up to 32GB LPDDR5X memory and the long battery life Snapdragon laptops are known for.

Processor.Processor: Snapdragon X X1 26 100 Processor (30MB Cache, up to 2.97GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads)

Display: 2.5K (2560 x 1600, WQXGA) 16:10 aspect ratio, Refresh Rate:60Hz refresh rate, sRGB: 100%, Anti-glare display, 0.2ms response time, 300nits, 1,000,000:1, 70% less harmful blue light, TÜV Rheinland-certified

Storage: 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.
512GB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.

I/O Ports: 2x USB 4.0 Gen 3 Type-C with support for display / power delivery (data speed up to 40Gbps)
2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A (data speed up to 5Gbps), 1x 3.5mm Combo Audio Jack

Input.Keyboard & Touchpad: Backlit Chiclet Keyboard, 1.7mm Key-travel, Precision touchpad, With Copilot key
Input.Camera: FHD camera with IR function to support Windows Hello, With privacy shutter

Battery.Power Supply: TYPE-C, 65W AC Adapter, Output: 20V DC, 3.25A, 65W, Input: 100-240V AC 50/60Hz universal, *Whether a charger is included varies according to country, region and model. Please check with your local ASUS retailer for details.

Operating System: Windows 11 Home - ASUS recommends Windows 11 Pro for business, *Windows 11 Home is available only as the Single Language edition in selected markets. Learn more about Windows 11 Home Single language: https://support.microsoft.com/article/eaf060a6-3642-4612-6b75-b34e57a08abf

Security: BIOS Booting User Password Protection, IR webcam with Windows Hello support
